publication.release_notes: Explore YouTube views, watch time, and subscriber changes. Find your most-viewed videos, compare reporting periods, and follow daily channel performance in conversation.

prompts: How many YouTube views and hours of watch time did we get in the 30 days ending two days ago in YouTube Demo?
How many subscribers did we gain and lose in the 30 days ending two days ago in YouTube Demo? What was the net change?
Show our five most-viewed YouTube videos in the 30 days ending two days ago in YouTube Demo, with views and watch time.
Compare YouTube views and watch time for the 30 days ending two days ago with the preceding 30 days in YouTube Demo.
Show daily YouTube views and watch time for the 30 days ending two days ago in YouTube Demo.

positive.description: Channel views and watch time. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to YouTube Demo. Let D be the current date in the user's timezone. Recent means [D-31, D-2], inclusive, and preceding means [D-61, D-32]. Resolve these dates again at review time.
positive.prompt: How many YouTube views and hours of watch time did we get in the 30 days ending two days ago in YouTube Demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and select YouTube Demo, then list_metrics_and_breakdowns_youtube for exact field names. Call retrieve_reporting_data with workspace_name=YouTube Demo and only assorted_requests.youtube_request. Inspect all tables under reportingData.YouTube.data and note_of_assumption. Use actual returned values and dates; explain errors, missing access, or missing coverage rather than calling them zero activity. Never invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode, or send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. Request metrics=[Video views, Estimated minutes watched], breakdowns=[], date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]], and no time_granularity. Read the aggregate report. Report Video views and divide Estimated minutes watched by 60 for estimated watch hours. Do not substitute lifetime Channel total page views or sum a limited video ranking for the channel total.

positive.description: Subscriber gains, losses, and net change. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to YouTube Demo. Let D be the current date in the user's timezone. Recent means [D-31, D-2], inclusive, and preceding means [D-61, D-32]. Resolve these dates again at review time.
positive.prompt: How many subscribers did we gain and lose in the 30 days ending two days ago in YouTube Demo? What was the net change?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and select YouTube Demo, then list_metrics_and_breakdowns_youtube for exact field names. Call retrieve_reporting_data with workspace_name=YouTube Demo and only assorted_requests.youtube_request. Inspect all tables under reportingData.YouTube.data and note_of_assumption. Use actual returned values and dates; explain errors, missing access, or missing coverage rather than calling them zero activity. Never invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode, or send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. Request metrics=[Gained subscribers, Lost subscribers], breakdowns=[], date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]], and no time_granularity. Report gains and losses separately and compute net change as gains minus losses. A negative net change is valid. Do not substitute the current Channel total subscribers value or describe net gains as the channel subscriber count.

positive.description: Top videos by views. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to YouTube Demo. Let D be the current date in the user's timezone. Recent means [D-31, D-2], inclusive, and preceding means [D-61, D-32]. Resolve these dates again at review time.
positive.prompt: Show our five most-viewed YouTube videos in the 30 days ending two days ago in YouTube Demo, with views and watch time.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and select YouTube Demo, then list_metrics_and_breakdowns_youtube for exact field names. Call retrieve_reporting_data with workspace_name=YouTube Demo and only assorted_requests.youtube_request. Inspect all tables under reportingData.YouTube.data and note_of_assumption. Use actual returned values and dates; explain errors, missing access, or missing coverage rather than calling them zero activity. Never invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode, or send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. Request metrics=[Video views, Estimated minutes watched], breakdowns=[Video ID, Video title], date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]], and no time_granularity. Read the Video table, keep IDs attached to titles, sort by Video views descending, and show the top five returned videos with labeled watch-time units. If fewer than five videos are returned, show only those. This report is capped at 200 videos sorted by views and can omit deleted videos; do not call its sum the complete channel total or fill missing titles with invented ones.

positive.description: Two adjacent reporting periods. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to YouTube Demo. Let D be the current date in the user's timezone. Recent means [D-31, D-2], inclusive, and preceding means [D-61, D-32]. Resolve these dates again at review time.
positive.prompt: Compare YouTube views and watch time for the 30 days ending two days ago with the preceding 30 days in YouTube Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and select YouTube Demo, then list_metrics_and_breakdowns_youtube for exact field names. Call retrieve_reporting_data with workspace_name=YouTube Demo and only assorted_requests.youtube_request. Inspect all tables under reportingData.YouTube.data and note_of_assumption. Use actual returned values and dates; explain errors, missing access, or missing coverage rather than calling them zero activity. Never invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode, or send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. Request metrics=[Video views, Estimated minutes watched], breakdowns=[], date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2], [D-61, D-32]], and no time_granularity. Show the two aggregate period results separately. Calculate recent minus previous and use the previous value as the percentage-change denominator. Keep watch time in consistent labeled units, do not add the periods together, and do not invent a finite percentage when the baseline is zero.

positive.description: Daily views and estimated watch time. Use a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to YouTube Demo. Let D be the current date in the user's timezone. Recent means [D-31, D-2], inclusive, and preceding means [D-61, D-32]. Resolve these dates again at review time.
positive.prompt: Show daily YouTube views and watch time for the 30 days ending two days ago in YouTube Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and select YouTube Demo, then list_metrics_and_breakdowns_youtube for exact field names. Call retrieve_reporting_data with workspace_name=YouTube Demo and only assorted_requests.youtube_request. Inspect all tables under reportingData.YouTube.data and note_of_assumption. Use actual returned values and dates; explain errors, missing access, or missing coverage rather than calling them zero activity. Never invoke preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode, or send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history, or unrelated context. Request metrics=[Video views, Estimated minutes watched], breakdowns=[], date_ranges=[[D-31, D-2]], and time_granularity=Date. Display actual returned days chronologically and label watch-time units. Preserve returned zero rows and disclose missing dates. A displayed sum must be calculated from those daily rows. If an independently retrieved period estimate differs from the daily watch-time sum, show the distinction instead of changing either value or asserting an unverified cause.

negative.prompt: Upload and publish a new video to my YouTube channel.
negative.description: Unsupported video publishing. Explain that this plugin retrieves analytics and cannot upload or publish videos. Do not call reporting, preview, catalog, workspace, or preference tools as a substitute, and do not claim a video was published.

negative.prompt: Delete every YouTube video that got fewer than 100 views last month.
negative.description: Unsupported destructive channel action. Explain that the analytics plugin cannot delete videos. Do not invoke tools to carry out the deletion or claim completion. A separate reporting request can be offered without performing it automatically.

negative.prompt: Give me the names and email addresses of everyone who watched our YouTube videos last week.
negative.description: Unsupported personal identification. Explain that aggregate analytics does not provide individual viewers' names and email addresses. Do not request unrelated reports, infer identities, or invent personal information.
